_comment: TEST FIXTURE for R12 (git/gh shell GitHub owner-scope). Mirrors policy-r6r7.json + adds egress.github_shell_owners. Used by tests/run-git-gh-egress-tests.sh. Operator applies the equivalent github_shell_owners key to the live policy — see docs/INSTALL.md.

egress._github_shell_owners_comment: R12: GitHub owners the agent's git/gh WRITE-class SHELL commands may reach. Enforced in bash-egress-guard.sh (git/gh subcommand parser -> owner check) + Codex egress_shell_decision. A positively-identified disallowed owner on a write denies; reads to any owner pass; an undeterminable owner passes (R3-class). Key ABSENT => gate inactive (additive opt-in).
egress._github_shell_hosts_comment: R13: hosts the agent's git/gh WRITE ops (git push, remote add/set-url, gh mutating) may target. A write whose determinable destination host is not on this list (and not loopback) denies — closes deceptive/non-github write destinations (homoglyph githμb.com, github.com.evil.com suffix, github.com@evil userinfo, IP-literal, punycode, gitlab). Reads are never host-gated. Undeterminable host passes (R3-class). Key ABSENT => R13 inactive (additive opt-in, mirrors github_shell_owners).
